name: red-widow
description: Gate VS Code-compatible IDE extensions, MCP config, and AI developer workflow risk from inside the editor.

redWidow.cliPath.description: Path to the Red Widow CLI executable.

redWidow.cliArgs.description: Optional arguments inserted before the Red Widow subcommand, such as ["-m", "red_widow"] when cliPath is python3.

redWidow.policy.description: Optional Red Widow policy JSON path, relative to the workspace or absolute.

redWidow.lockfile.description: Optional Red Widow lockfile path, relative to the workspace or absolute. Red Widow still auto-detects red-widow.lock.json when this is empty.

redWidow.offline.description: Run the gate in offline mode and skip marketplace resolution.

redWidow.failOnReview.description: Treat REVIEW decisions as failing gate runs.

redWidow.includeInstalled.description: Include locally installed VS Code-compatible extensions and global Cursor/Windsurf MCP config.

redWidow.runOnStartup.description: Run Red Widow automatically when a workspace opens.

redWidow.watchWorkspaceConfig.description: Watch IDE workflow configuration files and rerun Red Widow when they change.

redWidow.maxDiagnostics.description: Maximum number of Problems diagnostics created from a gate report.
